prompt: After an online game loss, several teammates pile onto one player for a mistake, even though the whole team played poorly. What response best helps in the moment?

options.text: Join the pile-on so the group does not turn on you next
Stay silent and leave as quickly as you can, because it is not your fight
Defend the player by insulting the loudest critic, starting a bigger argument
Calmly point out the loss was shared, steer the chat towards what to try next game, and check in with the blamed player afterwards

explanation: Redirecting to shared responsibility and the next game lowers the temperature without starting a counter-attack. Joining in is unfair, and insulting the critic just swaps the target of the pile-on.
